name: Strength of the Gods (Prayer)
body:
The gods of strength bless you with their strength.

Prerequisites: Worshiping a deity with the Strength Domain

Benefit: You gain a bonus to your Strength equal to (1/2 your character level) for a single Strength-based skill check (such as Climb or Swim) or a single Strength check once per day.
